notes.text: In the linked Bavli, Gursak bar Darei speaks in the name of Rav Menashya bar Shegovli, who cites Rav. [Two paragraphs later](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.29a.11), Rav Yosef says the teaching was attached to the wrong text. Both passages give Menashya the title Rav. [Heilprin’s Shegovli entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3277&lang=en) identifies Menashya as his son.
